strategic_objective: Develop and deploy an AI-generated legal contract template tool to capture the high-volume search gap and establish a performance-optimized solution for small businesses and freelancers.
kpi_target: Achieve 10,000 monthly active users and a 20% conversion rate to paid plans within the first 6 months of launch.

routing.CPO: Design and develop the AI-generated legal contract template tool with a focus on industry-specific templates and design quality.
routing.CMO: Create a marketing campaign to promote the tool and establish partnerships with legal professionals to review and validate the templates.
routing.CTO: Build and deploy the tool on a zero-cost infrastructure using open-source AI models and free hosting, ensuring scalability and performance.
routing.COO: Establish a process for user feedback and iteration, ensuring the tool meets the needs of small businesses and freelancers and maintains a high level of quality and performance.
